title: Encoded simulation input
statement: For a finite Boolean list $z$, define an encoding obtained by pairing twice: the inner pair consists of the fixed-increment transformation of the tail of $z$ with a final false bit appended (using the empty list if the transformation returns no value), and the defaulted first component of $z$; the outer pair consists of this inner encoding and the defaulted first component of the tail of $z$.
